text: Arshdeep Singh to Will Young, no run, starts off with an inswinger. 126 clicks and full in length, Will Young gets a huge inside edge as he looks to work it away
Arshdeep Singh to Will Young, no run, back of a length delivery outside off, Will Young punches it towards cover
Arshdeep Singh to Will Young, 1 run, pitched up by the bowler around middle and leg, Will Young flicks it towards wide mid-on for a single
Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, no run, slight width on offer outside off, Tim Seifert punches it towards cover

Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, 1 run, on a length around off, shapes back in as Tim Seifert gets an inside edge towards fine leg. That was very close to the leg-stump, didn't flick it luckily for the batsman

Arshdeep Singh to Will Young, , first boundary of the over! Short and wide outside off, Will Young frees his arms and carves it through the off-side for a rollicking boundary. There was a fielder chasing it, but nothing much he could do about it. The timing and placement were pristine enough
Auqib Nabi to Tim Seifert, no run, pitched up by the pacer around off, Tim Seifert drives it to cover. Sharp stop by Kohli inside the circle

Auqib Nabi to Tim Seifert, , another lovely shot. This time it's by Tim Seifert. This was pitched up by the bowler and Tim Seifert played a picture perfect on-drive, that races away to the fence in a canter
Auqib Nabi to Tim Seifert, , Auqib Nabi oversteps and there will be a free-hit coming.. On a length outside off and Tim Seifert lets it through to the keeper
Auqib Nabi to Tim Seifert, ,  On the shorter side around middle and Tim Seifert swivel-pulls it over deep square leg for a flat six. That was a powerful strike and would have been a six on any ground
Auqib Nabi to Tim Seifert, 1 run, drifting on the pads, Tim Seifert glances it away to fine leg for a single

Auqib Nabi to Will Young, no run,  On a length around off and the ball shapes away to catch the outside edge. Flies to Rohit at a comfortable height and the ball pops out of his grasp. Should have taken that, you won't get such easy chances

Auqib Nabi to Will Young, no run,  Kishan - the culprit on this occasion. Auqib Nabi cannot believe his luck. Stands there shell-shocked. Back of a length delivery around off and Will Young gets another outside edge as the ball shapes away. Kishan flies to his right and gets his right glove to it, but fails to latch on to the catch. Will Young living a charmed life
Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, no run, tad fuller around off, driven to mid-off by Tim Seifert
Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, , slight width on offer outside off, Tim Seifert plays it on the rise, lofting it over the infield at extra cover for a well timed chip shot. Away to the fence quickly
Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, no run, opens the bat face, steering this length delivery towards point
Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, no run, on a length around off, nips back slightly as Tim Seifert knocks it into the off-side watchfully
Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, no run, back of a length delivery outside off, Tim Seifert plays it off the back foot, steering it towards cover-point
Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, 1 run, driven to mid-off as the bowler goes full, that's a comfortable single taken
Auqib Nabi to Tim Seifert, 1 run, on a length around middle and leg, nudged to mid-on for a single
Auqib Nabi to Will Young, no run, sticks to his line outside off, nipping away ever so slightly, beating the batsman on the outside edge. He continues to trouble Will Young with that line outside off
Auqib Nabi to Will Young, no run, much closer to the batsman on this occasion, it's a length delivery around off, Will Young defends it from within the crease

Auqib Nabi to Will Young, , 131 kph, width on offer outside off, Will Young throws the kitchen sink at it, drilling it through cover where he manages to beat the fielder. Not a great delivery by Auqib Nabi - allowed the batsman to free his arms
Auqib Nabi to Will Young, no run, good length delivery around off, keeps straight, Will Young defends it from within the crease
Auqib Nabi to Will Young, no run, fraction short outside off, Will Young punches it on the rise, straight to the fielder at cover
Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, no run, full and quick around off, Tim Seifert goes for a drive, gets an inside edge towards mid-on
Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, no run, on a length around off, knocked into the off-side by Tim Seifert
Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, 2 runs, flicked over mid-wicket by Tim Seifert for a couple of runs. This was a length delivery around middle and leg
Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, no run, good length delivery around off, punched to the fielder at mid-off by Tim Seifert
Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, no run, pitched up by the bowler around off, Tim Seifert drives it towards mid-off on the bounce

Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, 2 runs, full and wide outside off, Tim Seifert drives it through extra cover for a couple of runs. Iyer chases it all the way to the boundary and pulls it back with a slide
Auqib Nabi to Will Young, no run, on a length around off, Will Young advances down the wicket to knock it towards cover
Auqib Nabi to Will Young, no run, back of a length around middle and leg, slides along the angle, Will Young looks to nudge it away, gets hit on the pads
Auqib Nabi to Will Young, 1 run, on a length around off, shaping away from the batsman, Will Young gets squared up on his defence, getting an outside edge towards third man
Auqib Nabi to Tim Seifert, no run, slides along the deck from a good length, Tim Seifert looks to nudge it away, gets hit on the pads
Auqib Nabi to Tim Seifert, 1 run, down the wicket to knock this towards mid-on for a single

Auqib Nabi to Will Young, no run, short and wide outside off, Tim Seifert advances down the wicket, slashing away from his body, only to connect thin air. Was very close to the wide guideline, the umpire being a little lenient on this occasion
Gurnoor Brar to Tim Seifert, no run, fullish and angled in on middle, Tim Seifert gets forward and flicks, was in the air for a while but lands miles short of mid-wicket

Gurnoor Brar to Tim Seifert, , that's a T20 shot. Full and in the slot on middle, Tim Seifert gets forward and clears his front leg to loft. Flies all the way over long-on. Dropped in the crowd. Went off the middle of the bat
Gurnoor Brar to Tim Seifert, no run, short of length outside off, Tim Seifert goes on the back foot and defends solidly to cover. "No run" Seifert screams

Gurnoor Brar to Tim Seifert, , beautiful back foot punch. On a back of a length outside off, even though he was cramped, Tim Seifert is on his tiptoes as he punches wide of backward point, no chance for Kuldeep running to his right at square third man

Gurnoor Brar to Tim Seifert, , Gurnoor Brar has been smashed for four but he is having words with Tim Seifert. It's short of length outside off, Seifert picks the length so well, goes on the back foot and smashes the pull, well wide of mid-wicket. No-one in the deep and Brar went after Seifert with words
Gurnoor Brar to Tim Seifert, no run, short of length outside off, Tim Seifert goes on the back foot and punches nicely to point, straight to the fielder
Arshdeep Singh to Will Young, 1 run, length delivery outside leg, Will Young flicks to deep backward square-leg for one
Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, no run, short of length down leg, Tim Seifert flicks and misses. Was a wide but it isn't given. Arshdeep Singh gets lucky
Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, no run, just  Length delivery on middle, Tim Seifert is opened up on the back foot block, the thick outside edge is found and Rohit dives forward but it doesn't carry
Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, no run, short of length and outside leg, Tim Seifert backs away and looks to push, the ball flies over the bat and the extra bounce takes it over the stumps
Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, 1 run, Tim Seifert now gives the charge and it's a length delivery on middle, dragged it off the thick inside half to mid-on, who's deep. Easy single on offer
Arshdeep Singh to Will Young, no run, back of a length outside off, angling away from the right-hander, Will Young goes on the back foot to punch and misses. Past the outside edge
Auqib Nabi to Tim Seifert, no run, fullish outside off, Tim Seifert gets forward to drive and loses his bottom-hand, finds cover

Auqib Nabi to Tim Seifert, , fullish outside off and even though Tim Seifert gets it low on the bat, he has found the elevation and power to go all the way over long-off. Had to reach out and got it over the fence
Auqib Nabi to Tim Seifert, , short of length and Tim Seifert pounces, goes on the back foot and pulls, beats the dive of mid-wicket to his right. Again picked the length so well and early
Auqib Nabi to Tim Seifert, no run, good length outside off, Tim Seifert gets forward and drives on the rise to cover-point
Auqib Nabi to Tim Seifert, 1 run, short of length outside off, Tim Seifert goes on the back foot and punches to deep backward point

Auqib Nabi to Will Young, , beautiful back foot punch. 15 off the over. Auqib Nabi is comforted with a few words by Rohit Sharma. It's a short of length delivery outside off, Will Young goes on the back foot and punches between cover and cover-point
Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, leg byes, , short of length and down leg, Tim Seifert goes on the back foot to flick and it's off the thigh pad, wide of Ishan Kishan to his left and runs away fine
Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, 1 run,  On a short of length on middle, Tim Seifert goes on the back foot and tucks it to deep backward square-leg. He raises the bat
Arshdeep Singh to Will Young, 1 run, full outside off, Will Young gets forward and drives to the left of Shreyas at mid-off. He fumbles but that was always one
Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, no run, fullish outside off, Tim Seifert gets forward and drives on the rise, but straight to the fielder at mid-off

Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, no run, short and a grunt from Arshdeep Singh after he delivered that. Tim Seifert goes on the back foot to pull and misses. Flies over the bat and Ishan Kishan leaps to collect
Arshdeep Singh to Tim Seifert, 1 run, short of length on middle and Tim Seifert goes on the back foot and nudges to the mid-wicket fielder who's on the edge of the ring
Axar Patel to Tim Seifert, , poor start from Axar Patel. He slides it down leg, good length and Tim Seifert glances fine. Well wide of Nabi at short fine, runs away
Axar Patel to Tim Seifert, 1 run, again slides down leg, length delivery and Tim Seifert goes on the back foot and tucks to deep square leg
Axar Patel to Will Young, no run, back of a length and curves into middle, Will Young goes on the back foot and knocks to mid-wicket.
Axar Patel to Will Young, 1 run, good length outside off, Will Young goes on the back foot and punches to long-off
Axar Patel to Tim Seifert, 1 run, flat good length and cramps Tim Seifert on middle and leg, makes room and punches to long-off
Axar Patel to Will Young, no run, tossed up full on middle, Will Young gets forward to flick to the right of mid-wicket, wants a quick single but Tim Seifert isn't interested

Gurnoor Brar to Tim Seifert, 1 run, short of length on middle, Tim Seifert goes on the back foot and closes the face of the bat to nudge to deep backward square-leg and Nabi is quick, he keeps it to one
Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, no run, short outside off, Will Young goes on the back foot and swivels to pull, but finds mid-wicket

Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, , what a fine shot that is. Short and rising outside off, Will Young rises tall and uses the pace and bounce to direct it wide of backward point. No chance for third man who's very square. Played it down too
Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, 1 run, back of a length outside off, Will Young goes on the back foot and opens the face of the bat to guide it down to third man where Rohit is there
Gurnoor Brar to Tim Seifert, no run, full and coming back into off, Tim Seifert gets forward to flick, the thick inside edge hits the leg and rolls to mid-wicket

Gurnoor Brar to Tim Seifert,  Caught by Ishan Kishan!! Gurnoor Brar sends Tim Seifert off. Words between them. It's short outside off, Seifert is rushed on the pull. The weight is on the front foot. High on the bat and it seems to be landing between Ishan Kishan and fine-leg but the keeper with the big gloves on runs to his left and dives forward to take it two-handed. That's a good catch as he judged it well. As soon as the catch was taken, Brar got in Seifert's face roaring in celebration. I0$ from Seifert. Even as Kohli was pushing Brar away, he roars a come on at Seifert. Surely pantomime villain stuff.
Axar Patel to Will Young, no run, sliding down leg, length delivery and Will Young goes on the back foot to tuck, misses. Missing leg-stump
Axar Patel to Will Young, no run, tossed up full on off, Will Young gets forward to defend to the left of Axar Patel who allows the ball to go to mid-off
Axar Patel to Will Young, 1 run, wide of the crease and full on off, Will Young gets forward to flick to long-on
Axar Patel to Nick Kelly, no run, flat good length on off, Nick Kelly goes on the back foot to defend
Axar Patel to Nick Kelly, no run, drifts into off and middle, Nick Kelly goes on the back foot to defend to the vacant forward short-leg area
Axar Patel to Nick Kelly, 1 run, tossed up full on off, Nick Kelly is half-forward and he gets a thick inside edge to fine-leg.
Gurnoor Brar to Nick Kelly, 2 runs, full and down leg, Nick Kelly gets forward and flicks through vacant mid-wicket. Mid-on cuts it off

Gurnoor Brar to Nick Kelly, no run, that's a good delivery. Short of a length and maybe pitched outside leg, seams away and opens Nick Kelly up, hit on the back arm - the left one. No arm-guard and that would've hurt

Gurnoor Brar to Nick Kelly, 1 run, full on off, Nick Kelly gets forward to drive to mid-off's left. Takes on Nabi and gets in easily. Puts in the dive to ensure he is safe even as the throw misses easily

Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, , all the way over fine-leg's head. It's short and clearly rushes Will Young for pace, he takes it on from around off, goes on the back foot and the top-edge helps. Sails over the fielder's head who's Kuldeep
Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, no run, short and outside off, rising even as Will Young goes on the back foot to pull. Misses and Ishan Kishan leaps to collect
Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, no run, length delivery down leg, Will Young flicks and misses. Off the pad to the mid-wicket area
Axar Patel to Nick Kelly, no run, flat back of a length on middle, Nick Kelly goes on the back foot and punches to the left of Axar Patel

Axar Patel to Nick Kelly,  Stumped!! Nick Kelly curses himself as he walks off. Has run past a straight one. Lovely delivery, tossed up and goes straight on outside off, Kelly comes down the track and looks to loft and misses. Past the outside edge and a simple chance for Ishan Kishan who makes no mistake. He's getting nice drift into the left-hander and this one he bowled it without any spin or drift. After the wicket, Kohli has a lengthy chat with Axar, probably giving him some advice.
Axar Patel to Dean Foxcroft, no run, flat back of a length and drifts into off, Dean Foxcroft goes on the back foot and defends to the cover fielder
Axar Patel to Dean Foxcroft, no run, again drift, back of a length and on middle, Dean Foxcroft goes on the back foot and defends watchfully.
Axar Patel to Dean Foxcroft, no run, full and curving into off, Dean Foxcroft gets forward to push, off the thick outer half and finds cover
Axar Patel to Dean Foxcroft, 1 run,  who fails to stop it to his left with a dive. It's full on off, Dean Foxcroft gets forward and drives to get off the mark
Gurnoor Brar to Dean Foxcroft, 1 run, full outside off, Dean Foxcroft gets forward to drive to sweeper cover
Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, no run,  On a short of length and angle in and then holds its line to beat the tentative prod of Will Young. It bounced too
Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, no run, short of length and zippy outside off, Will Young goes on the back foot and is rushed on the pull, misses. Clearly beaten for pace there

Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, , lucky four for Will Young. It's a short of length delivery and nips back in to off, Young defends close to the body, the thick inside edge flies over the stumps and goes well wide even as Ishan Kishan dives to his left to try and cut it off
Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, no run, full outside off, Will Young gets forward and across to drive to cover
Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, no run, short outside off, rising, Will Young slashes and misses. Flies over the top-edge
Axar Patel to Dean Foxcroft, no run, length delivery and curves into off and middle, Dean Foxcroft gets forward to push to the right of Axar Patel who gets across and cuts it off
Axar Patel to Dean Foxcroft, 1 run, tossed up and Dean Foxcroft comes down the track to drive this down to long-on
Axar Patel to Will Young, 1 run, good length and flat on middle, Will Young goes on the back foot and punches to long-on
Axar Patel to Dean Foxcroft, 1 run, flat good length outside off, skiddy, Dean Foxcroft goes on the back foot and cuts to the right of backward point
Axar Patel to Will Young, no run, good length and no room on off, Will Young goes on the back foot and punches it back to Axar Patel
Axar Patel to Will Young, 1 run, slower and fuller outside off, Will Young gets forward and drives to the left of extra-cover
Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, 1 run, yorker length outside off, Will Young jams down on it and squeezes it down to third man
Gurnoor Brar to Dean Foxcroft, 1 run, short of length on middle, Dean Foxcroft goes on the back foot and taps it in front of mid-on. Easy single in the end to Nabi
Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, 1 run, full on off, angled in, Will Young gets forward to flick to the right of deep square leg
Gurnoor Brar to Dean Foxcroft, 1 run, short of length and around off, Dean Foxcroft goes on the back foot and defends with soft hands into the vacant silly-point area

Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, no run, Rohit at mid-wicket dives to his right and saves four. Short outside off, Will Young absolutely smashed the pull and Rohit sticks out an outstretched right hand and half-stops. That's good enough. Gurnoor Brar claps and appreciates that effort

Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, , this time no chance for Rohit or deep square leg. Short outside off, predictable and Will Young is waiting for it, he goes on the back foot and smashes it wide of both mid-wicket and the deep fielder. Rockets away to the deep mid-wicket fence

Kuldeep Yadav to Dean Foxcroft, 1 run, tossed up full outside off, Dean Foxcroft goes on the back foot and drives to long-off. Nearly another one as the throw from Gaikwad is not stopped by Kuldeep Yadav but there's backing up

Kuldeep Yadav to Will Young, , Will Young takes the attack to Kuldeep Yadav. He comes down the track and it's tossed up full outside off, gets to the pitch of the ball and smokes the loft straight down the ground. He does hit well down the ground

Kuldeep Yadav to Will Young, no run, flat good length outside off, Will Young goes on the back foot and punches to the left of Kuldeep Yadav who manages to stop it despite Dean Foxcroft being in the way
Kuldeep Yadav to Will Young, 1 run, shortish and turning in from outside off, Will Young goes on the back foot and punches to long-on
Kuldeep Yadav to Dean Foxcroft, 1 run, short outside off, Dean Foxcroft goes on the back foot and punches to long-off
Kuldeep Yadav to Will Young, 1 run, lots of flight outside off, nicely looped up outside off, Will Young gets forward and drives to the left of Gaikwad at long-off. He keeps it to one
Auqib Nabi to Will Young, no run, short of length outside off, Will Young goes on the back foot and looked to pull that, but then changes his mind, defends to mid-wicket
Auqib Nabi to Will Young, 1 run,  A raise of the bat for his 13th ODI fifty. Met by Dean Foxcroft who gives him a handshake. Full outside off, he gets forward and drives to sweeper cover

Auqib Nabi to Dean Foxcroft,  Caught by Gurnoor Brar!! That's a good short delivery and surprised Dean Foxcroft as he came down the track to pull. Dug in short and follows the batter outside leg, pacy and Foxcroft still goes through with the pull, the top-edge flies to fine-leg and Brar takes it safely with the reverse-cup. Auqib Nabi has his arms outstretched in celebration. Maybe he saw the batter charging and decided to follow him. The ploy has worked.
Auqib Nabi to Finn Allen, no run, back of a length outside off, Finn Allen goes on the back foot and opens the face of the bat to guide it on the bounce to Rohit who's at a sort of fourth slip
Auqib Nabi to Finn Allen, no run, short of length and angled in on the fifth-stump line, hint of movement away, Finn Allen is beaten on the back foot. Just about carries to Ishan Kishan
Auqib Nabi to Finn Allen, no run, short of length on off, Finn Allen goes on the back foot and defends to the right of Auqib Nabi
Axar Patel to Will Young, no run, tossed up full outside off, Will Young gets outside off and sweeps to short fine
Axar Patel to Will Young, 1 run, good length and down leg, Will Young goes on the back foot and tucks it to the left of short fine
Axar Patel to Finn Allen, no run, flat back of a length outside off, Finn Allen goes on the back foot and punches to extra-cover. "Wait on, no run" is the cry from Allen I think
Axar Patel to Finn Allen, 1 run, flat back of a length outside off, Finn Allen goes on the back foot and punches to long-on
Axar Patel to Will Young, 1 run, tossed up full outside off, Will Young gets forward to drive to long-off
Axar Patel to Finn Allen, 1 run, good length outside off, Finn Allen goes on the back foot and punches to sweeper cover
Auqib Nabi to Finn Allen, , that's a short-arm jab and no deep square leg. It's a short of length delivery just outside off, Finn Allen goes on the back foot and pulls it over square leg. Runs away
Auqib Nabi to Finn Allen, 1 run, short of length and nips back in to off, Finn Allen goes on the back foot and defends to mid-wicket. "Yeah one" is the cry from Allen to Will Young
Auqib Nabi to Will Young, 1 run, short of length outside off, Will Young wants to get forward, then swivels to pull to deep backward square-leg
Auqib Nabi to Finn Allen, 1 run, short of length outside off, Finn Allen goes on the back foot and punches to cover, where Shreyas dives to his left and fumbles. Then they take one
Auqib Nabi to Will Young, no run, short outside off, Will Young lets it go as he sinks a bit
Auqib Nabi to Will Young, 1 run, short outside off, Will Young goes on the back foot and pulls it down, now there's a deep square leg in place
Axar Patel to Will Young, , he's a fine sweeper. It's on a length on off, Will Young gets low and then sweeps it behind square on the leg-side, no chance for deep square leg to his right
Axar Patel to Will Young, no run, tossed up full on off, bit of drift, Will Young gets forward to defend
Axar Patel to Will Young, no run, flat and round-arm, good length on off, Will Young defends
Axar Patel to Will Young, 1 run, slower and fuller outside off, Will Young gets forward to drive to sweeper cover

Axar Patel to Finn Allen, , smashed straight down the ground. It's full outside off, right in Finn Allen's arc, he gets forward and smokes it way back. Watches the ball sail away. Over the sightscreen and towards the cameraman
Axar Patel to Finn Allen, no run, short of length and cramps Finn Allen on middle, quicker and he goes on the back foot to push to the left of mid-wicket.
Kuldeep Yadav to Will Young, 2 runs, tossed up full on off, Will Young gets low and paddles it to fine-leg for two. Brar the fielder
Kuldeep Yadav to Will Young, 1 run, tossed up full on middle, Will Young gets forward and flicks to the right of mid-wicket for a quick single

Kuldeep Yadav to Finn Allen, , slashes and slashes hard. No chance for Rohit at slip. Flat length delivery outside off, Finn Allen goes on the back foot and slashes. Before Rohit put his outstretched right hand up, it flew past him and there's no third man
Kuldeep Yadav to Finn Allen, 1 run, tossed up full on leg-stump, Finn Allen gets forward and whips the drive to long-on

Kuldeep Yadav to Will Young, no run, may have been the googly, yes it is. On a good length on middle, turns away a tad, Will Young goes on the back foot to defend, catches the thick outside edge but rolls to backward point. Bit of extra bounce too
Kuldeep Yadav to Will Young, 2 runs, flat good length on leg-stump, Will Young goes on the back foot and tucks to deep square leg, the fielder is at deep mid-wicket and that's an easy two
Axar Patel to Finn Allen, no run, flat good length and curves into off, Finn Allen goes on the back foot and punches to extra-cover
Axar Patel to Finn Allen, 1 run, flat good length and curves into outside leg, Finn Allen goes on the back foot and punches to long-on
Axar Patel to Will Young, no run, short of length and no room for Will Young as he goes on the back foot and defends it back, to the right of Axar Patel
Axar Patel to Will Young, no run, slower and fuller outside off, Will Young gets forward to drive, the thick inside edge hits the back leg and rolls to the vacant silly-point area
Axar Patel to Will Young, no run, nicely tossed up on a length outside off, Will Young gets forward to drive to extra-cover

Axar Patel to Will Young, no run, back of a length and Will Young has missed out, goes on the back foot and cuts hard but straight to the fielder at extra-cover. Shreyas fumbles slightly but there's no chance of any risk being taken
Kuldeep Yadav to Finn Allen, 1 run, flat good length on leg and middle, Finn Allen goes on the back foot and punches to long-off. "Yeah one" is the call from Allen to Will Young

Kuldeep Yadav to Will Young, , what a fine sweep this is. Full on leg-stump, down goes Will Young and sweeps it hard and to the deep backward square-leg fence. The fielder just had a few metres to cover to his left but Brar has no chance and gives it up

Kuldeep Yadav to Will Young, 3 runs, tossed up full on middle, now the fine sweep even as Ishan Kishan tries to catch it with his left hand, goes away and a lot of work for Brar running around from fine-leg to his right. He dives and pushes it back, the ball is away from the hand and then his right boot touches the cushions. So that's fine. Good effort to save one

Kuldeep Yadav to Finn Allen, , , poor delivery and what's worse Kuldeep Yadav has overstepped as well. Down leg, short and almost a free-hit that for Finn Allen. He doesn't miss out, goes on the back foot and pulls well wide of deep backward square-leg where Brar is there. Again he has no chance

Kuldeep Yadav to Finn Allen, , . Tossed up on a good length on middle, Finn Allen gets forward and clears his front leg to heave and even though he didn't time it, it sails all the way over deep mid-wicket. Allen has a big wry smile on his face for he knew he didn't time that
Kuldeep Yadav to Finn Allen, no run, flat good length outside leg, Finn Allen goes on the back foot and punches it back to Kuldeep Yadav

Kuldeep Yadav to Finn Allen, no run, good length and the googly on middle and off, Finn Allen goes on the back foot and punches to extra-cover. An expensive over that from Kuldeep Yadav - 19 came off it
Arshdeep Singh to Will Young, 1 run, full outside off, angling away from the right-hander, Will Young dabs to third man with an open-face
Arshdeep Singh to Finn Allen, 1 run, back of a length outside off, Will Young goes on the back foot and cuts wide of sweeper cover. The call was for two but they are happy with one
Arshdeep Singh to Will Young, 2 runs, "wait, yes, two" is the cry from Will Young as he gets forward and drives it into the ground. Bounces over the leap of Kohli at cover. Easy two

Arshdeep Singh to Will Young, , Will Young is on the charge. He is on the attack here. Short outside off, he advances and pulls over mid-wicket and shouts of "catch it" from the Indians, but it's into the gap
Arshdeep Singh to Will Young, 1 run, Arshdeep Singh round the wicket now. On a short of length outside off, Will Young goes on the back foot and cuts to sweeper cover
Arshdeep Singh to Finn Allen, no run, dug in short and at Finn Allen who sways away and lets it go. That was a good short delivery
Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, no run, good length and tight on off, Will Young gets forward and right behind the line to defend it back
Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, , "catch" was the cry but this is all the way over square third man. It's short of length delivery outside off, Will Young slashes and it flies off the bat. Into the crowd

Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, no run, Axar dives to his right and saves runs at backward point. On a short of length outside off, Will Young goes on the back foot and punches that nicely with an open-face. If not for Axar that was probably four

Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, no run, short of length and tight on off, Will Young goes on the back foot and defends to his right. Wants a run as he looks at Finn Allen but they don't risk it as Gurnoor Brar chases

Gurnoor Brar to Will Young, , what timing from Will Young. It's a short of length delivery outside off, he goes on the back foot and punches with an open-face. Was in the air but well wide of Axar and square third man. A disappointed look from Gurnoor Brar as he knows he is giving too much width. Young is racing away to his 100

Lands this on a good length and Jamieson gets this straighten a bit off the deck. The line is around the fifth stump zone and Gaikwad has a defensive push at it. Thick outside edge goes to the right of 2nd slip and Bracewell gets low to take a sharp catch.

Kyle Jamieson to Axar Patel, no run,  Nick Kelly is the culprit. Steep bounce and Axar Patel can't control as he hops to dab. Hits him high on the bat and goes towards backward point. Kelly comes in and puts down a pretty straightforward catch
Kyle Jamieson to Axar Patel, no run, full delivery, push-driven towards cover off the front foot
Kyle Jamieson to Axar Patel, no run, 138kph, skids off the deck and Axar is rushed as he looks to defend from the crease. Hits the pad (outside leg) and rolls towards second slip
Matt Henry to Ishan Kishan, no run, 129kph, short of a good length, Ishan Kishan defends with a closed bat-face
Matt Henry to Ishan Kishan, no run, short and outside off, Ishan Kishan gets low before letting it pass
Matt Henry to Ishan Kishan, no run, length ball, defended into off
Matt Henry to Ishan Kishan, no run, 128kph, Ishan Kishan stays back to defend this short of a good length ball into the on-side
Matt Henry to Ishan Kishan, ,  Ishan Kishan steps out of his crease, the length is fuller and the line is wider. Allows him to free his arms and he's drilled it straight of mid-off
Matt Henry to Ishan Kishan, no run, short of length, Ishan Kishan covers the line to defend

Kyle Jamieson to Axar Patel, no run, in-seamer with extra bounce, Axar Patel doesn't expect the ball to move so much. Defends from the crease and gets beaten on the inside edge. The ball bounces over the middle-stump
Kyle Jamieson to Axar Patel, no run, full pitcher from Jamieson and Axar Patel is half-forward to defend
Kyle Jamieson to Axar Patel, no run, 135kph, shortened length, Axar nudges it adjacent to the pitch on the leg-side with soft hands
Kyle Jamieson to Axar Patel, no run, moves leg-side and defends this length ball into the off-side with an opened bat-face
Kyle Jamieson to Axar Patel, no run, stays leg-side to drive this full delivery and inside-edges towards midwicket
Kyle Jamieson to Axar Patel, no run, maiden over! Shortish ball, Axar Patel hops to get on top of the bounce and defends it to backward point
Matt Henry to Ishan Kishan, no run, 129kph, I0$, angling into the left-hander, Ishan Kishan defends it towards midwicket
Matt Henry to Ishan Kishan, , 129kph, hurled full by Henry. There's width as well and Ishan Kishan takes the aerial route as he biffs it over mid-off
Matt Henry to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, shortened length outside off, chopped towards backward point for a quick single
Matt Henry to Axar Patel, no run, 132kph, short ball, Axar Patel jumps to keep it out on the off-side. Hits him high on the bat

Matt Henry to Axar Patel, , Axar Patel gets off the mark with a boundary! 133kph, shortish length from Henry again. Axar gets into a good position with a hop. Gets on top of the bounce and is in good control of his shot as he cuts through the gap between backward point and cover-point
Matt Henry to Axar Patel, no run, change of angle, Henry switches to round the wicket and bowls a shortish ball outside off, the batter ignores

Kyle Jamieson to Ishan Kishan, no run,  133kph, away-angler from over the wicket that further seams away. Good bounce as well. Ishan Kishan gets forward for a defensive push and the ball beats the outside edge by a fair margin
Kyle Jamieson to Ishan Kishan, no run, 136kph, Jamieson gets this to curl back in a bit, Ishan Kishan trusts the bounce and shoulders arms. The line too is outside off

Kyle Jamieson to Ishan Kishan, , good shot! Back of a length, Ishan Kishan hops and opens the face of the bat to punch it nicely. Beats backward point to his left and the ball is quick to reach the fence
Kyle Jamieson to Ishan Kishan, no run, more bounce and closer to off on this occasion, a jumping Ishan Kishan drops it into the off-side
Kyle Jamieson to Ishan Kishan, no run, 130kph, pitched up delivery, a big forward stride from Ishan Kishan to block it to cover

Kyle Jamieson to Ishan Kishan, no run, round the wicket, short ball angling down. Ishan Kishan gets inside the line and tries to play the one-legged pull shot. Misses and there's half an appeal for caught behind
Matt Henry to Axar Patel, no run, full outside off, Axar Patel gets forward to drive and doesn't time to mid-off. Matt Henry is coming from round the wicket to the left-hander
Matt Henry to Axar Patel, 1 run, full outside off, Axar Patel gets forward and drives to the left of Santner at mid-off. Easy single this time
Matt Henry to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, short of length outside off, nips back in from there, Ishan Kishan goes on the back foot and nudges to the left of mid-wicket for a quick single
Matt Henry to Axar Patel, no run, short of length and tight on middle, Axar Patel is standing on leg-stump and he is not bothering to get in line, goes on the back foot and defends to backward point
Matt Henry to Axar Patel, no run, short of length outside off, Axar Patel goes on the back foot and punches straight to the fielder at cover-point. "Wait, wait" is the shout from Axar
Matt Henry to Axar Patel, no run, back of a length outside off, good leave that
Kyle Jamieson to Ishan Kishan, no run, good length outside off, Ishan Kishan goes on the back foot and guides it to backward point
Kyle Jamieson to Ishan Kishan, no run, full just outside off, Ishan Kishan gets forward to drive and finds mid-off. Crisply driven but straight to the fielder
Kyle Jamieson to Ishan Kishan, no run, full on middle and Ishan Kishan gets forward to flick to mid-on
Kyle Jamieson to Ishan Kishan, no run, short of length outside off, angling away from the left-hander, who lets it go
Kyle Jamieson to Ishan Kishan, no run, fullish on off, Ishan Kishan gets forward to defend to cover-point. Solidly behind that
Kyle Jamieson to Ishan Kishan, no run, short and down leg-side, Ishan Kishan ducks and Chris Brown makes the right call as this is not wide

Kristian Clarke to Axar Patel, no run, short of length outside off, Axar Patel reaches for it to cut and misses. He wants a wide and asks Kumar Dharmasena about it, it's inside the tramline and that's the right call
Kristian Clarke to Axar Patel, 2 runs, short of length and nips back in to leg-stump, Axar Patel goes on the back foot and nudges it deep backward square-leg. Easy two as it's into the gap
Kristian Clarke to Axar Patel, no run, wide of the crease and good length outside off, Axar Patel goes on the back foot and punches to cover-point
Kristian Clarke to Axar Patel, no run, back of a length outside off, Axar Patel goes on the back foot to cut and mistimes it to backward point. He tried to hit that too hard
Kristian Clarke to Axar Patel, no run, fullish outside off, Axar Patel gets forward to drive and Young is there at cover-point as he moves to his left to cut it off
Kristian Clarke to Axar Patel, 1 run, short on the stumps, Axar Patel goes on the back foot and hooks it down to the right of deep backward square-leg
Matthew Fisher to Axar Patel, 1 run, length delivery on middle, Axar Patel gets forward to drive wide of cover for one
Matthew Fisher to Ishan Kishan, no run, good length and tight on off, Ishan Kishan is nearly squared up as he goes on the back foot to defend to backward point
Matthew Fisher to Ishan Kishan, no run, full just outside off, Ishan Kishan gets forward to drive hard and straight to mid-off
Matthew Fisher to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, full on off, Ishan Kishan gets forward to drive to mid-on and a late call for one, but they make it easily in the end

Matthew Fisher to Axar Patel, no run,  It's a short of length delivery and pitches just outside leg, Axar is cut in half as he goes on the back foot to defend. The extra bounce takes it over the middle-stump and past the inside edge
Matthew Fisher to Axar Patel, no run, short and down leg, Axar Patel ducks and lets it go
Kristian Clarke to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, short outside off, Ishan Kishan goes on the back foot and pulls to deep backward square-leg for one
Kristian Clarke to Axar Patel, , cracking cut. Length delivery outside off, Axar Patel leans back and cuts hard and wide of backward point and cover-point. Right into the gap

Kristian Clarke to Axar Patel, 1 run, Ishan Kishan slips and it's just one. It's a short of length delivery outside off, Axar Patel cuts hard and Foxcroft slides to his left from sweeper cover and fields well
Kristian Clarke to Ishan Kishan, no run, fullish outside off, curving into off, Ishan Kishan with a solid forward defence to cover
Kristian Clarke to Ishan Kishan, no run, full on middle, angled in, Ishan Kishan gets forward to whip that to mid-on, but straight to the fielder

Kristian Clarke to Ishan Kishan, , second cut of the over. Length delivery outside off, Ishan Kishan goes on the back foot and cuts hard, it races across the turf. Sweeper runs to his right and dives, gets a hand but the ball wins. India needed that over as runs weren't coming at all

Matthew Fisher to Axar Patel, , that's another superb cut shot. On a short of length outside off, Axar Patel leans back and cuts so hard, beats the backward point who dives to his left. No sweeper cover and that's another four
Matthew Fisher to Axar Patel, 1 run, full outside off, Axar Patel gets forward to drive and it's in the air but wide of cover. Santner at mid-off gets across and cuts it off to his right
Matthew Fisher to Ishan Kishan, no run, short of length just outside off, Ishan Kishan goes on the back foot and punches to mid-off
Matthew Fisher to Ishan Kishan, no run, back of a length just outside off, Ishan Kishan goes on the back foot and defends solidly
Matthew Fisher to Ishan Kishan, 2 runs, good length and tight on off, Ishan Kishan defends from the crease, wide of backward point and they come back for two. Off the open-face

Matthew Fisher to Ishan Kishan, no run,  Sharp short of length delivery and zippy stuff, Ishan Kishan goes on the back foot and gets a thick inside edge on the flick. On to the pad. To the naked eye, the inside edge was clearly visible and Santner even checked with his mates if there was an edge. Also it looked like it didn't pitch in line. Nothing going right for that review

Michael Bracewell to Axar Patel, no run, tossed up full on middle, curve in and then spin away, Axar Patel gets forward to defend to backward point. That's a lovely delivery first up from round the wicket
Michael Bracewell to Axar Patel, 1 run, full down leg, Axar Patel gets forward to flick to deep square leg
Michael Bracewell to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, full on middle, Ishan Kishan gets forward to drive it gently down the ground to long-on
Michael Bracewell to Axar Patel, no run, fired into the pads, good length and Axar Patel flicks and misses. Clearly missing leg-stump
Michael Bracewell to Axar Patel, no run, slower and tossed up full outside off, Axar Patel gets forward to push to the left of cover
Michael Bracewell to Axar Patel, 1 run, full on off, Axar Patel gets forward to drive and it's in the air, but wide of cover. Long-off is pretty wide and it's just one

Matthew Fisher to Axar Patel,  Caught by Finn Allen!! Squared up and the partnership is broken. It's a short of length delivery around leg-stump, opens Axar up totally, he goes on the back foot to defend. Bit of bounce and the thick outside edge goes at a comfortable height to Finn Allen who makes no mistake at all at slip. Matthew Fisher has his first.
Matthew Fisher to Naman Dhir, no run, short of length and nips back in to middle and leg, Naman Dhir looks to flick and misses. High and also going down leg
Matthew Fisher to Naman Dhir, no run, back of a length and nips back in to off, Naman Dhir goes on the back foot to defend to mid-wicket
Matthew Fisher to Naman Dhir, no run, full and angled in on off, Naman Dhir gets forward to flick nicely but straight to the fielder at mid-on
Matthew Fisher to Naman Dhir, no run, pitched up outside off, Naman Dhir gets forward to drive and times it, but straight to the fielder at mid-off
Matthew Fisher to Naman Dhir, 1 run, full on middle, Naman Dhir gets forward and flicks to the right of mid-on and "yeah, yeah, yeah" is the shout from him as he gets off the mark
Michael Bracewell to Naman Dhir, 1 run, flat good length on off, Naman Dhir goes on the back foot and punches it down to long-on
Michael Bracewell to Ishan Kishan, no run, tossed up on a good length on off, Ishan Kishan gets forward to defend to point
Michael Bracewell to Ishan Kishan, no run, tossed up full on middle, Ishan Kishan gets forward to push it back to Michael Bracewell
Michael Bracewell to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, full on off, Ishan Kishan gets forward to drive to long-on
Michael Bracewell to Naman Dhir, 1 run, length delivery on middle, Naman Dhir gets forward to drive to long-on
Michael Bracewell to Ishan Kishan, no run, down leg, length delivery and Ishan Kishan sweeps to short fine. Was there for the boundary that ball

Matthew Fisher to Naman Dhir, , Chris Brown makes a late call for the wide. Naman Dhir asked him for it. Length delivery down leg, Dhir flicks and misses, Tim Seifert dives to his left to collect. Was clearly a wide. Brown was thinking about stretching his arms out, then Dhir gestured if that is a wide or not, then Brown signals for the wide
Matthew Fisher to Naman Dhir, no run, good length and just outside off, Naman Dhir goes on the back foot to defend to mid-off. Solidly behind that

Matthew Fisher to Naman Dhir, no run, back of a length and rising outside off, Naman Dhir goes on the back foot to defend, it rises high and flicks the glove and then go on to the right arm. Went down
Matthew Fisher to Naman Dhir, no run, short on the stumps, Naman Dhir bends his head and lets it go. Tim Seifert leaps a tad to collect
Matthew Fisher to Naman Dhir, 2 runs, full outside off, Naman Dhir gets forward and plays a punchy drive wide of cover. Easy two
Matthew Fisher to Naman Dhir, no run, short of length on middle, Naman Dhir goes on the back foot and tucks to mid-wicket who dives to his right and cuts it off
Matthew Fisher to Naman Dhir, , short and down leg, Naman Dhir ducks and lets it go. Called a wide
Matthew Fisher to Naman Dhir, no run, short of length outside off, Naman Dhir goes on the back foot and across to defend this solidly to backward point

Matt Henry to Ishan Kishan,  Bowled!! What a bowler Matt Henry is. He comes back and gets Ishan Kishan first-ball. Length ball from round the wicket, seams back in, Ishan gets forward to defend, leaves a bit of gap between bat and pad. The thick inside edge goes back on to the top of leg-stump. Just trimmed the bail. The dogged resistance of Ishan is over.
Matt Henry to Auqib Nabi, no run, fullish outside off, Auqib Nabi gets forward to defend solidly to cover
Matt Henry to Auqib Nabi, no run, short of length on middle, Auqib Nabi goes on the back foot to swivel to pull, is beaten for pace and misses. Thuds into the tummy region
Matt Henry to Auqib Nabi, , Auqib Nabi can bat. This is full on off and middle, no deep backward square-leg or deep square leg and he gets forward to flick it away wide of the square leg umpire
Matt Henry to Auqib Nabi, 1 run, short outside off, Auqib Nabi goes on the back foot and pulls to deep square leg
Matt Henry to Naman Dhir, no run, short of length outside off, Naman Dhir is on the walk as he defends to backward point. Was right behind the line
Matthew Fisher to Auqib Nabi, no run, just  Length delivery on the pads, Auqib Nabi flicks nicely and it almost carries to Bracewell
Matthew Fisher to Auqib Nabi, no run, fullish just outside off, Auqib Nabi gets forward to defend to backward point
Matthew Fisher to Auqib Nabi, no run, short of length and rising on off, Auqib Nabi goes on the back foot and defends to cover. Got behind that well

Matthew Fisher to Auqib Nabi,  Caught by Tim Seifert!! What a snorter that is. Too good for Auqib Nabi. Naman Dhir had a chat with him couple of balls earlier, probably giving him advice on how to handle the pacers. This is a good short delivery and right at Nabi, he leans back and looks to drop his gloves. Is late in doing so, flicks the left hand glove and Tim Seifert leaps a little to take it. That was always coming back in and was clocked at 143.4kph.
Matthew Fisher to Kuldeep Yadav, no run, short on the stumps, Kuldeep Yadav ducks
Matthew Fisher to Kuldeep Yadav, no run, fine delivery and Kuldeep Yadav is lucky not to outside edge that. Length delivery outside leg, seams away big and late to beat Kuldeep on the back foot block
Matt Henry to Naman Dhir, 1 run, short of length outside off, Naman Dhir goes on the back foot and helps the pull to deep backward square-leg

Matt Henry to Kuldeep Yadav, 1 run, back of a length outside off, Kuldeep Yadav goes on the back foot and opens the face of the bat to punch wide of backward point, who dives to his right. Easy two before third man comes around to his left
Matt Henry to Naman Dhir, no run, Naman Dhir wants to use his feet to try and counter Matt Henry. Length delivery outside off, he defends and it rolls to cover
Matt Henry to Naman Dhir, no run, length delivery outside off, Naman Dhir goes on the back foot and defends solidly to cover
Matt Henry to Naman Dhir, 1 run, short outside off, Naman Dhir goes on the back foot and helps the pull to deep square leg

Matt Henry to Kuldeep Yadav,  Bowled!!  That nagging line and length with a hint of nip-back. May have been the wobble-seam delivery as it lands on a length outside off, Kuldeep Yadav is late in getting forward to this. Doesn't cover the line or the movement, the ball nips back in to beat the inside edge and the defence to land on top of the off-bail. Again trims the bail and Henry has his arms in triumph.
Matthew Fisher to Naman Dhir, no run, short of length outside off, Naman Dhir hacks across the line and doesn't time it. Finds mid-on

Matthew Fisher to Naman Dhir, , change of bat and change in result. Full outside off, Naman Dhir gets forward and lofts over long-off. He can hit the ball well and this is a good hit. Was in the slot and mid-off was up

Matthew Fisher to Naman Dhir, , what a pull. Probably the shot of the match. It's a short of length delivery outside off, Naman Dhir stays on the front foot and murders the pull. Dropped by a Ferrari-cap wearing gentleman in the crowd. That was right off the screws and the sound when ball met bat was thunderous

Matthew Fisher to Naman Dhir, no run, what a good riposte. It's a searing short delivery and at Naman Dhir, he wants to back away and steer it away. Doesn't and Tim Seifert has to leap to collect. That was bowled with more effort and pace

Matthew Fisher to Naman Dhir, 2 runs, lands beyond the  It's a short of length delivery outside off, Naman Dhir goes on the back foot to pull, miscues it and it went a long way up in the air. Jamieson goes back and looks to catch it in front of him. But it lands well in front of him

Matthew Fisher to Naman Dhir,  Caught by Mitchell Santner!! This time he falls. It's a short of length delivery outside off, Naman Dhir looks to flay and splices it up. Santner goes from extra-cover and moves to his left to take a simple catch. That rushed Dhir for pace and he was in no position to play that. Yet he had to go for his shots as there's not much batting at the other end. Dhir wanted to go over the leg-side but the ball bounced a lot more than he expected. He shakes his head as he walks off.
Matt Henry to Gurnoor Brar, no run, short of length outside off, loose poke from Gurnoor Brar and he nearly edges it behind. A forward short-leg is there deep with the helmet on
Matt Henry to Gurnoor Brar, no run, short and down leg, Gurnoor Brar manages to evade that. The Kiwis giving it back to Brar with words

Matt Henry to Gurnoor Brar, no run, short of length and nips back in to off, Gurnoor Brar goes on the back foot to defend. The bottom-hand comes off and it goes wide of forward short-leg who's Young. They don't take the single
Matt Henry to Gurnoor Brar, , short outside off, Gurnoor Brar sways away from the line and lets it go. Tim Seifert leaps to take it and the wide is given
Matt Henry to Gurnoor Brar, no run, back over the wicket. On a short of length and moves away from middle, Gurnoor Brar goes on the back foot to defend, the late away movement beats the bat
Matt Henry to Gurnoor Brar, no run, short of length on middle, Gurnoor Brar goes on the back foot to defend to backward point. Solidly behind that

Matt Henry to Gurnoor Brar, 1 run, short of length on off, Gurnoor Brar goes on the back foot and opens the face of the bat to guide it down to third man. Matt Henry came round the wicket for this one
Matthew Fisher to Gurnoor Brar, no run, shortish down leg, Gurnoor Brar is in an awkward position as he nudges to mid-wicket. The bottom-hand came off as he was rushed for pace
Matthew Fisher to Gurnoor Brar, no run, superb short delivery and Gurnoor Brar is again rushed for pace. He goes on the back foot and is on his tiptoes as he defends it down to backward point
Matthew Fisher to Gurnoor Brar, , short of length down leg, Gurnoor Brar flicks and misses. Called a wide
Matthew Fisher to Gurnoor Brar, 1 run, back of a length on middle, solidly behind that as Gurnoor Brar goes on the back foot and defends wide of backward point for one. Opened the face there
Matthew Fisher to Arshdeep Singh, no run, shortish outside leg, Arshdeep Singh backs away to pull, the thick inside edge just misses the stumps and goes to Tim Seifert

Matthew Fisher to Arshdeep Singh, no run, Matthew Fisher follows Arshdeep Singh outside leg with a yorker. Had it been in line with the stumps, would've been problems for the batter, who fails to dig it out

Matthew Fisher to Arshdeep Singh, , short of length and following Arshdeep Singh well outside leg, he looks to help the pull and misses. Tim Seifert dives to his right with an outstretched right hand and saves four more. Superb take
Matthew Fisher to Arshdeep Singh, no run, now Arshdeep Singh shuffles across outside off and looks to play the scoop. This is just  Full and Arshdeep had no time or chance to lay bat on ball
Matt Henry to Gurnoor Brar, , short and flies over Gurnoor Brar as he looks to evade that. Called a wide for height. That rose over his head
Matt Henry to Gurnoor Brar, no run, fullish outside off, Gurnoor Brar gets forward to push, no feet and he is beaten
Matt Henry to Gurnoor Brar, no run, wide of the crease and short of length outside off, Gurnoor Brar again is beaten as he plays a leaden-footed poke

Matt Henry to Gurnoor Brar, no run,  This is a short delivery and targetting Brar who looks to fend at that, the ball misses the glove and pings him on the right arm. He doesn't call for the physio and is ready to face the next ball

Matt Henry to Gurnoor Brar,  Bowled!! Fittingly Matt Henry finishes it off. Handshake between Gurnoor Brar and Will Young. No feet from Brar as Matt Henry bowls the very full delivery on off, the seam came out scrambled and Brar stays leg-side of the ball, pushes at it and it sneaks under the bat to hit the base of off-stump. New Zealand have thumped India by 244 runs as the series heads to the decider on the same ground 2-1 in favor of India.
